a.name: AI-allowed
a.description: Any generative AI tool permitted during Session One learning and essay writing; a dedicated ChatGPT (GPT-4o) account was supplied. Standard online resources were also permitted. AI and other external resources were prohibited for all knowledge tests and for the Session Two essay (PDF pp. 7-10, Sections 2.1-2.2; PDF p. 53, Figure A2). Arm counts refer to assigned sign-ups and the Session One study sample, not the outcome-specific essay sample.

a.name: AI-forbidden
a.description: Generative AI prohibited during Session One learning and essay writing; standard online resources such as Google, Wikipedia, and the college library website were permitted. AI and other external resources were prohibited for all knowledge tests and for the Session Two essay (PDF pp. 7-10, Sections 2.1-2.2; PDF p. 53, Figure A2). Arm counts refer to assigned sign-ups and the Session One study sample, not the outcome-specific essay sample.
